method: Independent primary-source review and deterministic local edge/differential tests against the frozen direct implementations.
scope: Rust CandidType callbacks, no_std typed tree, and no_std native source visitor
TypeScript SDK-schema/native-value visitor and shared writer
OCaml native descriptors, conversions, record getters, and variant selectors
Compiler-generated CXTY layout metadata, Motoko RTS heap visitor, and standalone typed-memory ABI

primary_direct_paths: Rust CandidType: used-shape callbacks, then direct payload callbacks
TypeScript: typed value/shape visitor, then direct emitter
OCaml: native descriptor/getter visit, then direct emitter
Compiler/RTS: original heap values through DirectSource; static layout metadata and root handles, without a materialized payload tree
separate_interfaces: The standalone typed-memory ABI marshals a typed tree; its host/node conversion cost is separate from native heap traversal.
The temporary native Motoko library remains the authorized encode-and-normalize implementation.

deterministic_checks.oracle: canonicalize(SDK ordinary encoding), plus output re-canonicalization
deterministic_checks.covers: All scalar kinds, exact float edges, valid Unicode scalar text and exact UTF-8, nested options, recursive aliases, record pruning, variant unions/reindexing, empty vectors and binary subarrays, integer typed arrays, numeric label collisions, output type-table 1024/1025, poisoned SDK encodeValue.
Float-view rejection, spoofed vector length, true principal length, 1025 unused source declarations with a tiny derived output, and absent/empty Empty/Func/Service children.

deterministic_checks.oracle: Valid native strings match canonicalize(SDK ordinary encoding), re-canonicalize unchanged, and decodeCompatible reconstructs exact strings. Invalid native witnesses must throw.
deterministic_checks.covers: Unicode boundary scalars, minimum/maximum surrogate pairs, literal U+FFFD, BOM/NUL/combining text, nested vectors/options/records/variants, unpaired high/low surrogates and bad adjacency, first/second getter validation, and rejection of newly present formerly omitted fields.

deterministic_checks.count_method: 39 value differential cases, 3 positive boundary/dynamic cases, 6 tree rejection cases, and 6 custom serializer rejection cases.
deterministic_checks.covers: Native units/newtypes, flattened and wrapped variant payloads, serde_bytes, nested options, exact integer magnitudes, dynamic explicit types, label ordering/collisions, binary steps/depth, output table bounds, shape flips, swallowed errors, and forgotten compounds.

deterministic_checks.language: Rust adaptive source cache and warmed callbacks
deterministic_checks.oracle: Canonical ordinary Candid where representable within raw-input limits; unchanged typed-tree encoding for unused-schema and alias boundary cases; output re-canonicalization.
deterministic_checks.covers: Fresh Rc types in 4096-field variants/records, 1025 unused compound declarations, metadata field/node quota fallback, aliases and recursive schema reuse, cached/uncached alias depth 256/257, absent/empty Empty/Func/Service children, malformed cached variant IDs, and warmed swallowed-wrong/forgotten/missing-flat callbacks.

deterministic_checks.oracle: Unoptimized typed-tree join/emission, plus output re-canonicalization
deterministic_checks.covers: 27 optional-field presence combinations paired across record vectors, nested vectors, and variant unions; scalar-kind/compound mismatches; binary slice length; both-pass shape/step bounds; output table 1024/1025; 32 MiB output; 4096-byte scalar LEB; empty vectors at depth 256 versus nonempty children at 257.

Pruning versus explicit null/reserved and Some(None), recursive/View aliases, scalar ranges, malformed UTF-8, oversized principals, IEEE bits, binary/array/list aliases, source ID collisions, variant selection, and output table 1024/1025.

fixed_findings.before: Blob byte elements skipped the ordinary traversal/depth charges: 2000000 root bytes and a nonempty Blob at depth 256 could encode outputs rejected by the normalizer.
fixed_findings.after: Root bytes 1999999 are accepted; 2000000 bytes and a nonempty byte child at depth 257 reject.

fixed_findings.before: A getter returning Some on the first visit and None on the second could return noncanonical bytes; formerly omitted None fields could hide a later Some.
fixed_findings.after: Both visits enforce bounds, emitted used shapes are compared with the first roots, and omitted fields are inspected again; both presence flips reject.

fixed_findings.before: Flattened record payload callbacks bypassed record label ordering checks; duplicate source variant IDs could also be accepted.
fixed_findings.after: Shared source field-order validation covers records, source variant cases, and flattened payload records.

fixed_findings.before: A Bool source serializer swallowing serialize_nat8's error returned DIDL with an uninhabited empty root: 4449444c00016f. Reused child shapes could also obscure an incomplete later callback.
fixed_findings.after: Visits reset the completion sentinel, reject missing complete values, and retain child/output-bound failures even when custom callers ignore callback results.

fixed_findings.before: An eager shape-depth walk rejected 256 present options around an empty binary/nonbinary vector because the unused element type was at 257, while the established encoders/normalizers accepted the value.
fixed_findings.after: Used value/join/emission depth accounting is retained; empty vector depth 256 accepts and nonempty child 257 rejects.

fixed_findings.before: Float32Array([1]) under Vec Nat32 encoded direct integer 1 instead of the SDK's IEEE bits 0x3f800000; Float64Array/Vec Nat64 had the same problem.
fixed_findings.after: Intrinsic integer typed-array brands and widths are checked; float/DataView and spoofed views reject.

fixed_findings.before: Uint8Array([1,2]) with public length=3 emitted [1,2,0]. A 30-byte Principal view with public length=29 bypassed the principal bound and truncated to 29 bytes.
fixed_findings.after: Intrinsic backing-storage metadata produces trusted views; vector metadata spoofing rejects and principal validation uses the actual native span.

fixed_findings.before: Forgetting a nonempty serialize_vec compound skipped Drop completion checks and could leave a truncated payload.
fixed_findings.after: Each visit checks balanced compound counts; forgotten roots and swallowed forgotten-child errors reject.

fixed_findings.before: Unpaired high and low UTF-16 surrogates were silently replaced with U+FFFD by TextEncoder; all three inputs encoded to 4449444c00017103efbfbd and decoding lost the original code unit. The ordinary SDK shared this coercion, masking it in differential tests.
fixed_findings.after: Both source visits validate surrogate pairing in the UTF-8 length scan and reject malformed native Text. The emitter reuses the validated length; valid scalar strings, paired surrogates, literal U+FFFD, and exact UTF-8 bytes are unchanged.
contract_basis: Pinned Candid spec/Candid.md Text definition: Unicode scalar values

layout_review: Verified lazy/moved BigInt access through mp_int_ptr, bounded significant bits/used limbs, and 60-bit limb extraction without ordinary LEB construction.
Verified true=1 pointer exception, null sentinel, single Some unboxing, unsigned Nat64 versus signed Int64 shifts/boxed Bits64, Float32/Float64 bits, and Char conversion.
Verified tuple array order, Candid IDs versus Motoko heap hashes, sorted object hash lookup, variant mapping, Blob/text borrowing and rope flattening.
Verified no callback or GC increment while Rust borrows heap spans; scratch/output/schema values are discarded before result publication through allocation_barrier.
Inspected standalone pointer/span/index/flag/depth checks; standalone ABI validation and compiler execution results are captured separately by the compiler/RTS owner.
contracts: Custom serializers, getters, converters, and source metadata must be accurate and stable during both visits. Shape checks do not compare scalar contents of the same kind.
Low-level tree/source vector values must originate from one uniformly typed source schema with accurate optional-field metadata; arbitrary heterogeneous record trees are outside that contract.

Native Text denotes Unicode scalar values. TypeScript strings with unpaired UTF-16 surrogates reject; the binding does not silently replace them with U+FFFD. Valid text and numeric schema-label IDs keep their existing bytes.
provenance: Focused harnesses are local ignored _out files; public regression source paths are listed for every fixed finding. Complete source-final corpus/fuzz and performance captures are separate reports.
final_change_review: TypeScript Unicode checks preserve the valid Text domain and reject invalid native UTF-16; no cx wire contract change.

Rust std-only callback source metadata cache activates after 32 actual callback events; bulk primitive item charges do not activate it. Rc pointer keys stay alive; cached nodes are capped at 1024 and aggregate field/case entries at 4096. Excess metadata uses the original uncached descriptors, preserving wide-schema acceptance. Only selected variant children are registered. Core join/emission and no_std RTS traversal remain unchanged.
Callback completion, sticky child/writer failures, compound balance, actual shape consistency, and both-pass budgets remain enforced.
